instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: In the hospital waiting room, 3 people are wearing casts. This makes up 12% of the people. How many people are in the waiting room in total.
atoms.b: There are <mat><gap>25</gap></mat> people in the waiting room.

atoms.a: There are lots of people in the waiting room because one doctor is not able to be there. If he makes up 6.25% of the total number of doctors, how many doctors are there in total?

Once Patricia is called to be seen by a doctor, the doctor tells her that 3 bones in her wrist are damaged. This makes up 37.5% of the bones in the wrist. Work out how many bones there are in the wrist in total.
atoms.b: There are <mat><gap>8</gap></mat> bones in the wrist.

atoms.a: Another patient waited 18 minutes to see a doctor. This was 90% as long as they expected. How long did they expect to wait for?
atoms.b: They expected to wait for <mat><gap>20</gap></mat> minutes to see the doctor.

atoms.a: When the doctor finishes their day, they say that they spent 90% of their time at work with patients which equates to 7.2 hours. How long were they working for in total?
atoms.b: They were working for <mat><gap>8</gap></mat> hours in total.
